name: Griffin
description: The Griffin is a legendary hybrid creature with the body of a lion and the head, wings, and forelimb-talons of an eagle. Attested from Bronze Age Near Eastern art and central to Greek and medieval European heraldry.
origin: A creature of myth and iconography. Imagery extends from Predynastic Egypt and Mesopotamia through Bronze Age Crete, the wider Mediterranean, the medieval Christian West, and into modern heraldry.
